notes.title: Yuri Game Festival~
notes.content: [p]The first Yuri Game Festival will be held from September 10th to September 20th! I am deeply grateful to the organizers for giving me the opportunity to participate.[/p][p]Players interested in Yuri game please don't miss it~[/p][p]At the game festival, there will be many excellent yuri games and games containing yuri elements, as well as many new yuri games that have not yet been released. I believe there will be one that interests you![/p][p][/p][p]PS: The discount for "The Neverending Summer" will start on September 16th. If you are interested, you may consider purchasing it after the 16th.[/p]
